results.summary: Fixed the tail function in more_itertools/recipes.py to handle cases where the requested tail size is larger than the iterable length. results.name: tomli-unicode-escape
results.summary: Fixed incorrect parsing of \\uXXXX escape sequences in TOML basic strings. The bug was in src/tomli/_parser.py where parse_hex_char was called with hex_len=3 for \\u escapes, but the TOML spec requires exactly 4 hex digits. Changed hex_len from 3 to 4. All tests now pass.
